content_type: personalized derivative learning material; not a replacement of the PEL100 original corpus
evidence_policy: Listening and repeating are practice, not independent mastery evidence. Never invent personal facts or learner scores.

units.title: 我是誰 · Who I Am
sentences: Hello, my name is Chung-Kuang Chen.
I am from Taiwan.
I am from National Taiwan University of Science and Technology.
My work is about AI and energy management.

focus.T: 現在式：目前身分與領域
focus.L: 姓名 → 來自哪裡 → 學校 → 領域

units.recombine_task: 只選兩項符合當下場合的真實資訊，不必照原順序，也不必說完整四句。
units.practice_question: Could you tell me a little about yourself?
units.transfer_task: You meet someone on a train. How would you introduce yourself?

units.title: 我的工作 · What I Do
sentences: I work with AI and power data.
I use data from buildings and machines.
I look for changes in how machines use energy.
My goal is to help people save energy.

focus.L: 領域 → 資料 → 做什麼 → 目的

units.recombine_task: 改用自己當前專案的真實資料或對象；一次只替換一項，不新增職稱。
units.practice_question: What do you do in your work?
units.transfer_task: A new coworker asks what you do. How would you explain it without using AI as an abbreviation?

units.title: 我的研究 · My Research
sentences: My research is about power data.
I study how machines use electricity.
I use AI to find patterns in the data.
The goal is to understand how machines work.

focus.T: 現在式：研究範圍與方法
focus.L: 研究主題 → 觀察對象 → 方法 → 目的

units.recombine_task: 用兩句連接研究對象與目的；不要加入未確認的實驗數字或成果。
units.transfer_task: A friend does not know your field. How would you explain your research?

units.title: 為什麼做這件事 · Why This Matters
sentences: I study power data because I want to understand energy use.
The data can show changes in a machine.
These changes can help us find possible problems.
I want to make this information easier to use.

focus.T: 現在式與 can：目的及可能用途，不宣稱已證實效果
focus.L: 原因 → 資訊 → 可能用途 → 目標

units.recombine_task: 以 because 連接一項工作與真實原因；區分『希望做到』與『已證明做到』。
units.practice_question: Why do you study power data?
units.transfer_task: Someone asks how your work could help them. What would you say?

units.title: 最近做了什麼 · A Recent Task
sentences: I worked on an English talk for a conference.
I checked the script and the slides.
I asked for simpler words.
I also asked for audio to practice with.

focus.L: 任務 → 檢查 → 調整 → 練習準備

units.recombine_task: 回想自己最近一件真實任務，替換任務與兩項行動；不知道結果就不補結果。
units.practice_question: What did you work on recently?
units.transfer_task: A colleague asks what you did to prepare for your talk. How would you answer?
source_refs: Current PEL conversation: user requested conference scripts/audio, compared slides and script, and requested simpler words. This describes preparation, not a claim that the conference talk has already been delivered.

units.title: 接下來想做什麼 · My Next Step
sentences: I want to explain my work in simple English.
I plan to practice with short audio lessons.
I would like to answer questions in my own words.
I want to use these sentences in real conversations.

focus.T: want to、plan to、would like to：目標與計畫，不是已達成
focus.L: 目標 → 練習方式 → 自主回答 → 實際應用

units.recombine_task: 把目標換成自己下一次真正想做的事，說出一項可行的練習方式。
units.practice_question: What would you like to do next?
units.transfer_task: You have only a short time to practice today. What is your plan?
source_refs: Current PEL conversation: user requested basic English for explaining their work, listening/shadowing audio, and the 100-episode practice collection. These sentences state learning intentions, not measured ability.
